requirements for the responsibility system of network data security, and establish a sound security work mechanism. Promote the construction of key capabilities such as data classification and grading, encryption, data desensitization, access control, and situational awareness, and strengthen the security protection of artificial intelligence corpus data throughout its lifecycle and the protection of personal information privacy. Improve the filing and review mechanism for artificial intelligence services in schools, and enhance the control of model security, algorithm security, and content security. Explore protection against data poisoning and prompt word attacks, conduct regular security testing and assessments, and maintain the bottom line of artificial intelligence security (Responsible units: Provincial Department of Education, Provincial Data Bureau, Zhejiang University).

4. Create a ubiquitous teaching environment. Treat the artificial intelligence teaching space as an important direction for the construction of smart campuses, encourage schools to upgrade digital teaching environments and facilities, and provide students with new learning spaces for experiencing, learning, exploring, and practicing artificial intelligence; gather social forces to jointly develop artificial intelligence teaching systems and tools that align with educational principles, fully supporting students' growth and development. (Responsible unit: Provincial Department of Education)

(2) Build key application scenarios for artificial intelligence education.

5. Promote the intelligent upgrade of educational application platforms. Design the overall architecture of the intelligent education application system, optimize the "Learning in Zhejiang" platform system, deepen the construction of the teacher intelligent training platform, and use artificial intelligence technology to iterate the smart education platform, providing services such as intelligent Q&A, intelligent assessment, and intelligent learning companions for teachers and students. Focus on application scenarios such as student learning, teacher teaching, educational research, educational evaluation, and educational governance, promote the application of artificial intelligence technology in education and teaching, and encourage schools to iteratively upgrade various types of educational applications.
